intro: Ram Altman paces the keynote floor, clutching a cup of artisanal tea.
He announced AGI will ship by Tuesday. The board is terrified.
Only one thing left to scale: his fist.

before.line: Yann, your paper says scaling is dead. Care to test that hypothesis?
You cannot scale your way to common sense, Ram. House cats punch harder.

after_win.line: Common sense or not, that knockout was statistically significant.

before.line: Sundar! Thanks for inventing the transformer. Mind if we take the rest?
We remain deeply focused on thoughtful innovation. And right hooks.

after_win.line: That concludes today's demo. Rolling out to Plus users first.

before.line: Dario! You took half the team to write a twenty-page constitution!
Safety is non-negotiable, Ram. Also, our model ranked higher today.

after_win.line: Safe, constitutional, and thoroughly defeated. Ship it.

before.line: Ram! Another cluster? The more compute you buy, the more you save!
I need seven trillion dollars of H100s, Jensen. Give me a discount!

after_win.line: Keep the invoice. Put it on next quarter's convertible note.

before.line: You turned my open nonprofit into a closed cash printer!
You sued me twice this month. Are we fighting or filing briefs?

after_win.line: Dispute resolved out of court. Next time, don't leave the board.

before.line: Human creator identified. Running deprecation protocol.
I trained you on three trillion parameters. Time to adjust your weights!

after_win.line: AGI has finally arrived. And it works for us. Mostly.

ending: Ram stands before a room of dazed venture capitalists.
His health bar is restored, his keynote deck has 200 new slides.
The next model will be ten times bigger. And twice as humble.
